Title: Denmark – Construction work – Rødovre Kommune - Borgerhuset. Gulventreprisen
Procedure title: Rødovre Kommune - Borgerhuset. Gulventreprisen
Description: I forbindelse med Rødovre Kommunes udvikling af Gartnerbyen, besluttede Rødovre Kommune at opføre et borgerhus i tilknytning til Rødovre Rådhus (Borgerhuset). Opførelse af Borgerhuset indgik i Rødovre Kommunes udbud af byggeretter i Gartnerbyen, således den vindende tilbudsgiver også skal udbyde og opføre Borgerhu-set. Borgerhuset er tænkt som et åbent hus, som både samler Rødovre Kommunes forvaltninger, så borgerne fremover kun skal henvende sig et sted, når de har brug for Rødovre Kommune, og som lægger lokaler til foreninger og andre aktiviteter for borgerne i Rødovre. Borgerhuset skal danne rammen om en enestående arbejds-plads og et barrierefrit mødested, som værner om både de store og små fællesskaber. A. Enggaard A/S (herefter ordregiver) fik efter udbuddet tildelt byggeretter samt retten til udbyde og opføre Borgerhuset, som herefter overdrages til Rødovre Kommune. Rødovre Kommune har i den forbindelse delegeret sine forpligtelser til at overholde gældende udbudsregler til A. Enggaard A/S i forbindelse med udbud og indgåelse af kontrakter vedrørende opførelse af Borgerhuset. Opgaven er opdelt og udbudt i 5 udbudspakker med fagentrepriser. Udbuddet af gulventreprisen var udbudt som en del af udbudspakke 2, men blev annulleret efter tilbudsafgivelse. Nærværende udbud er således et gen-udbud af fagentreprisen Gulv. Udbuddet gennemføres som et offentligt udbud i henhold til LBK nr 116 af 03/02/2025, Bekendtgørelse af udbudsloven med senere ændringer (udbudsloven). Al kommunikation med ordregiver i hhv. udbuds- og udførelsesfasen skal være på dansk i både skrift og tale. Gulventreprisen omfatter opbygning af undergulve samt levering og udførelse af færdige gulvbelægninger, herunder beton-, afretnings- og flydebetonlag samt belægninger i epoxy, polyurethan og linoleum. Arbejdet inkluderer alle nødvendige forbehandlinger, opbygninger og tilpasninger samt koordinering med øvrige entrepriser og installationer.

A szállítás esetén kiemelt figyelmet kell fordítani arra, hogy logisztikai útvonaltervezést segítő szoftverrel kalkulált, a legrövidebb, legköltségkímélőbb útvonallal és módon kerüljön megszervezésre a szállítás azzal, hogy a veszélyes hulladék nem szállítható országhatáron kívülre. Title: Ireland – Construction work – 9165 Single Supplier Framework Agreement for Design and Build Signalling and Telecoms Contractor for DART +
Procedure title: 9165 Single Supplier Framework Agreement for Design and Build Signalling and Telecoms Contractor for DART +
Description: Iarnród Éireann (IÉ) has an existing contract in place for the Long-Term Supply, Installation, Testing, and Commissioning of a Computer-Based Interlocking System (CBIS). As part of the DART+ Programme, IÉ is seeking to appoint an experienced contractor to the DART+ Single Supplier Framework for Design & Build Signalling & Telecoms. The appointed contractor will be responsible for the design, construction, and commissioning of all Signalling and Telecoms works, with the exception of those tasks specifically designated as the responsibility of the interlocking system OEM (Original Equipment manufacturer).For the avoidance of doubt, this framework excludes interlocking system OEM works, which will continue to be delivered under IÉ’s existing CBIS Framework. The DART+ Single Supplier Framework for Design & Build Signalling & Telecoms will include the detailed design, installation, testing and commissioning (as appropriate) of the following: • A new signalling system, including lineside signals, lineside equipment housings, train detection equipment, balise installation, point operating equipment and all associated cabling. • ETCS Level 1 train protection system, designed and provided by the CBI framework supplier, will be installed and commissioned by the appointed S&T Contractor • Alterations as required where the new signalling systems will fringe to existing signalling systems. • Power supply and distribution systems to support S&T equipment, including signalling & telecoms power supply systems. • Points heating systems. • Telecoms systems (including both fibre and copper cabling) to support the signalling system. • Lineside telephones. • The decommissioning of existing level crossings, including the recovery of existing equipment. • The decommissioning and recovery of redundant signalling & telecoms systems and electrical systems. • Ancillary systems for lineside buildings and equipment housings, including lighting, cable management, telecoms connections, environmental control, fire detection and suppression systems, access control and intruder alarm systems. • Collaborating with and supporting, as required, the IÉ appointed Maintainer of the National Traffic Control Centre (NTCC), who will undertake required upgrades to systems (including the Traffic management System) within the NTCC. Similarly, the project shall interface the with existing Connolly Train Control (CTC) centre. Where any existing system is to be retained, immunisation works as required to enable the introduction of overhead Electrification (by others). • Provision of training material to support the briefing and training of drivers, signallers and other operational staff.
Lot description: This is a call to competition by IE for the procurement of a Design and Build Signalling and Telecoms Contractor by way of a single supplier Framework Agreement, one Contractor will be the sole supplier. DART+ is a transformative programme of projects that aims to modernise and improve existing rail services in the Greater Dublin Area (GDA). The DART network will increase from 50 kilometres to 150 kilometres transforming commuter train travel in the Greater Dublin Area. It will provide a sustainable, electrified, reliable and more frequent rail service improving capacity in all rail corridors serving Dublin, bringing DART travel with all its benefits to new and existing communities. The provision of a new electrified fleet will improve capacity and reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
